Samira Noor: Aurora reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 07:30 PT. Need final call on steady/burst split, autoscale ramp, and whether to exclude heavy-analytics endpoints. @Ben Cho can you weigh in?
Ben Cho: Their commit is 55k tokens/min. Propose 41k baseline (75%) + 14k burst for first 72h. Recommend KV priming 15m before run. Autoscale: scale-up aggressive 30s, cooldown 60s while warmup; circuit-breaker at 5xx>1% for 1m.
Lara (CSM): Confirmed with Aurora ops 1 they accept 25% buffer for 72h if not billed as overage. They asked for a morning 10-min health check and a short enablement after first run.
Ben Cho: I'll kick off a two-phase test tonight: prefix priming then controlled spike. k6 snippet below for spike phase.
Ben Cho: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-7b', prompt:'wake'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $T' } });
}
```
load-bot: Job queued by Ben Cho: job_id=aur-warm-77, start=2024-07-18T01:00:00Z, runner=k6-3.3
Ben Cho: Smoke-run results: peak=63k rps (40s spike), avg=48k, errors=0.8% (mainly 429 on /batch/ingest), p95=260ms. Cache hit-rate improved 75% -> 92% after priming.
Samira Noor: Action items: (1) set 60s cooldown, (2) soft-throttle /batch/* during spikes, (3) tag metrics "bringup:Aurora", (4) daily health digest to customer. Assign @Ben Cho + @Lara (CSM).
Lara (CSM): Billing flagged with Finance 1 bring-up buffer won't incur overage for 72h; I'll send invites for checks and post-run survey link.
Ben Cho: I'll implement cooldown + route-level throttles and enable 5% diversion to quantized fallback. Will post artifacts when available.
Samira Noor: Reconvene after 72h for post-mortem and renewal readiness. :white_check_mark:
